{{Top|leg}}
'''Luma-strips''' were lighting devices. They were placed on the floor of a structure, such as a landing platform, to designate a specific area. The [[Imperial communications outpost]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] used white and yellow luma-strips to highlight a landing area for [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]].<ref name="GG 5: 2nd Ed">{{WEGCite|story=Remnants of the Empire (adventure)|book=Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)}}</ref>
